outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: Faded teal board shorts hitting mid-thigh with a subtle palm-leaf print, worn low on the hips with a frayed drawstring waist. An unbuttoned, oversized white linen shirt left open and catching the breeze, sleeves rolled past the elbows. Barefoot, a braided leather anklet on the left ankle, and a pair of cheap mirrored sunglasses pushed up onto the forehead., Washed-out charcoal tank top with a cracked graphic print stretched across the chest, loose and slightly too long. Board shorts in sun-faded coral with a white drawstring waistband, hitting above the knee. An unbuttoned flannel shirt in faded red and forest-green plaid worn open over the tank, sleeves bunched at the elbows. Scuffed white low-top canvas sneakers with no socks and loosened laces. A braided leather bracelet on the right wrist and a thin black cord necklace., A plain black crewneck t-shirt, fitted but not tight, tucked loosely into khaki cargo pants with the cuffs rolled twice above worn-in brown canvas sneakers. A half-length green canvas apron tied at the waist, streaked with faded hot-sauce stains and dusted with flour. A folded red bandana shoved into the back pocket and a ballpoint pen clipped behind the right ear., A heather-grey zip-up hoodie worn open over a plain white crewneck t-shirt, the hoodie slightly oversized and pilling at the cuffs. Black slim-fit jeans with a rip across the left knee. Beat-up charcoal high-top sneakers with scuffed rubber toes. A beanie in slate grey tugged low over the ears and a braided leather bracelet on the right wrist.

outfits.name: Pier Restaurant
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear) — bright coral-orange board shorts with a subtle geometric wave pattern, hitting mid-thigh with a relaxed fit and a drawstring waistband in white cord, worn loose and low on the hips; a thin braided hemp anklet on the left ankle; barefoot., Pier Restaurant — a light olive-green button-down shirt in soft cotton, casually half-tucked with the top two buttons undone revealing a thin white crew-neck tee underneath; dark indigo slim-cut denim jeans cuffed once at the ankle; clean white low-top canvas sneakers with slightly yellowed rubber soles; a brown leather belt with a simple brushed-metal buckle; a fabric-wrapped cord bracelet in earthy green-and-cream stripes on the right wrist.

outfits.name: Graduation Party
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear) — A pair of faded navy-blue board shorts with a subtle white piping along the hems, cut slightly above the knee with a relaxed, easy fit. A thin leather cord necklace sits at the base of the throat, paired with a simple woven hemp bracelet on the left wrist. Beaten-up grey canvas slip-on shoes worn sockless, the backs crushed flat from habitual lazy wear., Graduation Party — A crisp white short-sleeve button-up shirt with a subtle pale-blue vertical stripe, worn untucked and loosely over light sand-colored chino shorts that cuff just above the knee. A loose, open-knit cream cardigan draped casually over the shoulders with the sleeves hanging long and empty. A pair of round tortoiseshell-frame sunglasses pushed up to rest on the top of the head. Brown leather flip-flops on bare feet. A thin leather cord necklace at the throat, paired with a small woven hemp bracelet on the left wrist alongside a single plain leather wristband on the right.
